design_note: Faction identities and regional affiliations are authored from the seven-continent atlas. Diplomatic values are campaign state, not hard-coded assumptions about player choices.

factions.name: The Crownlands
factions.description: The disputed royal court and its remaining loyal offices.
factions.stance: Claims lawful succession while the throne remains contested.

factions.name: House Brennhallow
factions.description: A highland house rooted in fortress marches, mines and old military obligations.
factions.stance: Protects its mountain roads and inherited obligations.

factions.name: House Ysmark
factions.description: One of Eldrimar's six noble houses; its regional seat is not yet established in playable content.

factions.name: House Quillon
factions.description: A highland house associated with observatories, archives and old roads.
factions.stance: Values knowledge, records and control of strategic passes.

factions.name: House Vessmoor
factions.description: A plains house whose influence follows rivers, horse country and toll roads.
factions.stance: Protects trade routes and river crossings.

factions.name: House Tarnholt
factions.description: A monastic house with influence over cloisters, relic roads and religious institutions.
factions.stance: Defends its religious autonomy and custodianship.

factions.name: House Orrowen
factions.description: An old forest house tied to the weald, its villages and boundary roads.
factions.stance: Guards the old forest boundaries and local communities.

factions.name: House Dunmarrow
factions.description: The fallen house whose surviving heir is Torren Dunmarrow.
factions.stance: Seeks truth and restoration through the Hidden Codicil; it begins without recognized regional control.

factions.name: The Tidebound Assembly
factions.description: A council of harbour powers, pilots and island principalities.
factions.stance: Balances port autonomy, safe passage and beacon security.

factions.name: The Nine Wells Compact
factions.description: A water-law compact linking caravan princes and oasis city-states.
factions.stance: Treats water rights and aqueduct security as matters of survival.

factions.name: The Hearthfjord Jarldoms
factions.description: Northern jarldoms bound by kinship, sea routes and winter obligations.
factions.stance: Prioritizes local sovereignty, mutual defence and winter stores.

factions.name: The Lantern Synod
factions.description: A northern religious institution preserving observatories, records and sacred lights.
factions.stance: Protects its sanctuaries and the knowledge entrusted to them.

factions.name: The Thorn Courts
factions.description: A network of woodland courts and old-root settlements.
factions.stance: Defends the ancient forest compacts and its own succession customs.

factions.name: The Free Ranger Lodges
factions.description: Independent lodges that maintain trails, refuges and wilderness pacts.
factions.stance: Resists central control of the wild roads.

factions.name: The Meridian League
factions.description: A league of ports, foundries and charter houses.
factions.stance: Uses charters, shipping access and industrial agreements to secure influence.

factions.name: The Independent Sky Monasteries
factions.description: Autonomous high monasteries connected by pilgrimage and sky routes.
factions.stance: Preserves independence and the sanctity of the high routes.

factions.name: The Covenant of the Seven Flames
factions.description: A transregional secretive power whose influence intersects the succession crisis.
factions.stance: Its internal aims and command structure remain deliberately unresolved.
